annotation.title_clean: Evaluation of BEREC and the BEREC Office
annotation.title_en: Evaluation of BEREC and the BEREC Office
annotation.summary_en: Commission Staff Working Document evaluating the performance of BEREC (Body of European Regulators for Electronic Communications) and the BEREC Office for 2019-2023 under Article 48 of the BEREC Regulation. It finds them generally effective and efficient, but notes a mismatch between national regulator competences and BEREC's mandate. AI is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: BEREC has delivered its EECC guidelines, opinions and databases, but the guidelines leave flexibility to national regulators and do not ensure a single market.
NRA competences (digital markets, cybersecurity, spectrum) do not match BEREC's tasks, which limits its coherence and relevance.
The BEREC Office should take a larger role in data collection and analysis, with matching resources.
The Office has high staff turnover and deviates from Commission guidance on staffing.
The mandate may need to be adapted for the Digital Networks Act and other digital frameworks.
